description: A shell script for testing git archive attributes, including setup, various archive commands, pathspecs, worktree attributes, and export-subst features.

methods.name: test_expect_exists
methods.description: Checks if a file exists, expects success by default.

methods.name: test_expect_missing
methods.description: Checks if a file does not exist, expects success by default.

methods.name: test_expect_success
